title: ADR-0093 D3 amendment: bulk import binds the administrator's current organization in multi mode after #34535
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQ2SN4K183oqAvUajA

Filing gate ②: ADR bookkeeping owed by PR #34750 (#34535, maintainer ruling 6942842013, option B). Dedupe: `ADR-0093 bulk import multi mode`; no open card.

Suggested-grade: p2 (inherits #34535) · domain:skills (`docs/adr/**`, governed ⇒ Tier H) · documentation · Blocked-by #34535

## What goes stale

`docs/adr/0093-tenancy-mode-and-membership-lifecycle.md`, the closing paragraph of the D3 amendment (2026-10-24), lines 272–274 on main:

> This is not the reconciler guessing a tenant: the reconciler, and every other
> creation path (self sign-up, bulk import, SSO JIT, host hooks), still binds
> nothing in multi mode.

Once PR #34750 merges, bulk import does bind in multi mode (to the administrator's current organization), so that sentence becomes false.

## Suggested replacement (drafted by the area from PR #34750's body)

> This is not the reconciler guessing a tenant: the reconciler, and every other
> creation path (self sign-up, SSO JIT, host hooks), still binds nothing in
> multi mode.
>
> Bulk import (`POST /api/v1/auth/admin/import-users`) follows the rule above
> row by row (maintainer ruling on #34535, option B; landed by PR #34750): the
> settlement runs before any row is written, dry run included, so an
> administrator with no current organization is refused whole
> (`400 NO_ACTIVE_ORGANIZATION`) and a server with no unit of work or no
> organization plugin answers `501 NOT_IMPLEMENTED`; each created row's account
> and its join to the administrator's current organization are one unit of
> work, so a refused join creates no user for that row; an upsert-matched
> existing user joins in the same unit as its profile update, which a refused
> join rolls back. Single mode is unchanged.

Re-read the merged PR's `Acceptance notes` FROM → TO table before landing and correct the paragraph if the PR changed in review. Cite the merge commit in the amendment.
